searchText: Normally it means the author isn't actively iterating on it and is seeking feedback on what will otherwise be the final version of the EIP. "Review" means they are still actively iterating with reviewers, but the EIP is fully formed and "complete" in the sense that it has all of the necessary pieces. Draft means "I have an idea but not all of the details hammered out yet".
